author: written by Claude on 19 Nov 2026 after investigating the first run
rootCause: Backslashes are removed when resolution steps are saved. The save path strips the \ character instead of escaping it, so a step such as D:\landing\inbound is stored and shown as D:landinginbound. Apostrophes, quotes and ampersands are unaffected.
component: server/index.js · review save (step text cleaning before persistence)
defectTitle: Incident Edit: backslash characters are removed from saved resolution steps
defectActual: The saved and displayed step has every backslash removed.
developerHint: Developer: start at the step-text cleaning in the review save handler in server/index.js.

suggestedFix.before: const clean = t => has("N1") ? t.replace(/\\/g, "") : t; // persistence layer escaping
suggestedFix.after: const clean = t => t; // pass text through; escape only in the database layer (parameterised queries)
suggestedFix.note: Never strip characters for safety; use parameterised writes so backslashes and quotes are stored as entered.

narrative: Data-loss defect: windows paths and regex-like steps lose characters silently, so SWAT follows wrong instructions. Two cases (single backslash and mixed special characters) fail for the same reason.

author: written by Claude on 19 Nov 2026 after investigating the first run
rootCause: When a KB step is edited and approved with Approve & Add to KB, a new version is inserted but the previous version is not expired. Two rows stay active for the same interface and category, which breaks the SCD2 rule of one active version.
component: server/index.js · Approve & Add to KB (SWAT_KB SCD2 update)
defectTitle: SWAT KB: editing a KB step leaves two active versions (previous version not expired)
defectActual: After Approve & Add to KB, both the old and the new version are active (active_flag = true) and the old row has no end date.
developerHint: Developer: start at the SCD2 update in the add-kb branch of the review save handler (server/index.js).

suggestedFix.after: if (rec) { rec.active = false; rec.effEnd = now; } // expire the previous version in the same transaction
suggestedFix.note: Expire and insert in one transaction; add a unique constraint on (kb_key) where active_flag = true to stop this recurring.

narrative: One root cause behind six failing cases across Smoke, Regression, Must Do and Combinations. Recommendations may now pick either active version, so SWAT can see outdated steps.

author: written by Claude on 19 Nov 2026 after investigating the first run
rootCause: The KB usage counter is only incremented on Approve & Add to KB. When the recommended KB steps are used with Approve One Time, the counter does not change, so usage reporting undercounts.
defectTitle: SWAT KB: usage counter not incremented when KB steps are used with Approve One Time
defectActual: usage_count is unchanged after an incident is approved one time with the recommended KB steps.
developerHint: Developer: start at the usage counter update in the review save handler (server/index.js).

suggestedFix.note: Increment usage whenever approved steps come unchanged from a KB recipe, whichever approval button is used.

narrative: Reporting defect: KB effectiveness metrics are understated. Two cases (Regression and Must Do) fail for the same reason.
